proved_scope: Primitive outer-endpoint and label-bound witnesses for every finite symbolic closure path.
Sound broad target and source envelopes, with FLOW treated as TOP only in boolean guards.
Target-oriented mapped-stop / backward FLOW-prefix derivations equal the prior entry projection.
Explicit-versus-lazy initial-result sets under the same bounded AP emitter and its locality contract.
Explicit-versus-lazy paired summary-result sets under the same C5 reducer and its distinct entry/exit locality gates.
False static guard preserves ordinary demand plus existing ZERO/carry adapter outputs.
Genuine backward-ZERO bypass is dispatched before paired restriction; no forward-ZERO bypass.
A colored writer followed by FLOW requires a guard that can accept a transported output color.
Pointwise protection-mask OR is commutative, associative, idempotent and retains a late protected membership for equal payload keys.
not_proved: AP geometry/overlap/index adapter completeness, all-run E/mx/tail/field-limit/protection transport.
Whole ND premise matching and packed-summary merge policy.
Prescan owner-visibility construction or private ZERO/carry AP adapters.
Transition capture coverage, native-record persistence ownership, lookup-cache lifetime or absence of production mutation.
A production scheduler termination/complexity bound or exact finite visited-state key.
Spring cleanup semantics, whole JVM observations or measured time/memory savings.
The four OR laws do not establish exact production payload keys, mask-tree shape or canonical result accumulation; those remain adapter obligations.

measured_context.limit: Campaign context only; not a performance result for this design.
